data.narrative:
Mindgrove Technologies is a Series A-stage semiconductor company that has raised ₹85 crore (~$10M) to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 3 same-stage private peers in Chips & Semiconductors (SambaNova Systems, Rebellions, d-Matrix) and 3 public semiconductor benchmarks (ALAB, NVDA, AMD).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression methodology applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $10M raised proxy, yielding $20M. Peer-Median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables produces a median valuation of $2.3B, with a range spanning $2.0B (d-Matrix) to $11.0B (SambaNova Systems). Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied because Mindgrove's revenue is not disclosed. The public sector median P/S multiple is 20.5x across the three tickers, but lacks a revenue input for application.

The two applicable methods produce a wide triangulated range: $17M (low), $1.2B (median), and $2.7B (high). The median estimate of $1.2B sits meaningfully above stage-progression but substantially below the peer median, reflecting the marked valuation dispersion within early-stage semiconductor funding. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the peer set given the $9B spread between d-Matrix and SambaNova, and the absence of revenue or technology differentiation data to weight peers appropriately.
